description: This file defines the ProductPurchased controller class within the OpenCart admin extension. It manages the presentation, saving configuration settings, and generating reports related to purchased products, including methods for rendering views and processing AJAX requests for report data.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Product Purchased' report in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Render the main report configuration form view, setting up breadcrumbs, buttons, and loading necessary layout controllers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handle saving report configuration settings via POST, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Render the report view with report data and order statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Return the report list view via AJAX or direct output.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generate the report data, handle filtering, pagination, and prepare the data for the report view.
